# FAQ-008 Engineering FAQ #8

Revision: Rev A

Q1: What lubricant is specified for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02)?
A1: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-611 for EQ-P3-L3-CN02. Confirm supply and shelf location per SOP-P1-L4-03.

Q2: What lubricant is specified for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01)?
A2: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-961 for EQ-P1-L2-RR01. Reference SB-1043 for application guidance and contamination control.

Q3: What lubricant is specified for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01)?
A3: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-477 for EQ-P1-L4-CN01. Coordinate with maintenance ordering per ECN-2026-013 when replacing stock.

Q4: What is the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02)?
A4: Set the austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P3-L4-HT02 to 885 °C. Validate setpoint changes using the heat treat procedure in SOP-P1-L4-03 and record in the furnace log.

Q5: What is the coil cooling water flow requirement for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02)?
A5: Maintain coil cooling water flow minimum for EQ-P2-L1-IH02 at 55 L/min. Monitor flow alarms and document any deviations per SB-1043 and notify engineering per ECN-2026-013.

Related documents: ECN-2026-013, SB-1043, SOP-P1-L4-03.
